request.description:
Upload a document to a specific load for a given user. "filename" should be a string value of the name of the file including the file extension. Supported filetypes are PDF and JPEG. The "filebytes" should be a base64-encoded string.

What is returned inside of the "data" object of the response under the key "sha" is used to identify this specific document in this load. It is used to delete the document from the load if needed, so keep it handy.

Authorization should be the id_token received when authenticating, and passed in the headers under the "Authorization" key.

Delete a specific document from a specified load for a user. The document sha passed in under the "doc_sha" key is the sha returned at the time of originally uploading the document.

Authorization should be the id_token received when authenticating, and passed in the headers under the "Authorization" key.
